name: Rap Video Studio
tagline: Turn photos into AI rap videos.
description: Rap Video Studio is an AI rap video generator that turns photos into short, personalized performances. Start with a photo of one or two performers, choose a scene, and add a topic or your own lyrics to shape the performance. The studio supports people, cats, and dogs, and offers solo and duo formats. Once your video is ready, you can watch it and download it as an MP4. It’s a playful way to create birthday shout-outs, personal messages, and other creative moments.
